    Realizing a wide subcategory by a single presilting perpendicular #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_presilting_perpendicular_of_wide (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (he : IsEFinite R) {W : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat R)} (hw : IsWideClass W) :
    ∃ (P : TwoTerm R), P.IsPresilting ∧ ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), W X ↔ Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential ⟶ X) ∧ Subsingleton (X ⟶ TwoTerm.nakayamaKernel k P)

    If the algebra is E-finite, every wide subcategory is the full perpendicular category of one two-term presilting complex.
